_note: v2.8 plan 31 D-P5 offset proof, no model. Payload goldens carry none of the moved blocks, so this fixture proves the move directly: a story with a player block, eight player lines, then a dry run. The player-role block must be registered at depth 4 and land after the fifth-last chat line and before the fourth-last one; at the old depth 10 it sat above every line.

requires.why: dry run only; no generation, no judge

steps.eval: for (const name of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[name]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; return { cleared: true };

const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await until(() => rt.getSnapshot().playerSetup?.pending === false, 15000, 'the identity step to settle'); const view = rt.getSnapshot().playerSetup; if (view?.injected !== true) throw new Error(`the player-role block is not injected: ${JSON.stringify(view ?? null)}`); const block = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts?.story_orchestrator_player_role; if (!String(block?.value ?? '').includes('a lantern-bearer for hire')) throw new Error(`the player-role prompt does not carry the role: ${JSON.stringify(block ?? null)}`); if (block.depth !== 4) throw new Error(`the player-role block is registered at depth ${block.depth}, expected 4`); return { depth: block.depth, position: block.position };

steps.send: SO-P5-M1 I check the lamp oil.
SO-P5-M2 I tighten my pack straps.
SO-P5-M3 I look back down the road.
SO-P5-M4 I count the posts behind us.
SO-P5-M5 I listen for the mine bell.
SO-P5-M7 I step over a fallen beam.
SO-P5-M8 I raise the lamp toward the gate.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); let prompt = null; const text = (data) => { if (data?.dryRun && typeof data.prompt === 'string') prompt = data.prompt; }; const chat = (data) => { if (data?.dryRun && Array.isArray(data.chat)) prompt = JSON.stringify(data.chat); }; ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_COMBINE_PROMPTS, text); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.CHAT_COMPLETION_PROMPT_READY, chat); try { await ctx.generate('normal', {}, true); } finally { ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_COMBINE_PROMPTS, text); ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.CHAT_COMPLETION_PROMPT_READY, chat); } if (typeof prompt !== 'string') throw new Error(`the dry-run prompt was not captured (main API ${ctx.mainApi})`); const role = prompt.indexOf('a lantern-bearer for hire'); if (role < 0) throw new Error('the dry-run prompt does not carry the player-role line'); const lines = ctx.chat.map((m, id) => ({ id, at: prompt.indexOf(String(m?.mes ?? '').slice(0, 40)) })).filter((row) => row.at >= 0); if (lines.length < 6) throw new Error(`only ${lines.length} chat lines found in the dry run`); const before = lines.filter((row) => row.at < role).length; const after = lines.filter((row) => row.at > role).length; if (after !== 4) throw new Error(`the player-role line sits above ${after} chat line(s) of ${lines.length}, expected 4 (depth 4)`); if (before < 1) throw new Error('the player-role line sits above every chat line, as at the old depth'); return { chatLines: lines.length, before, after, promptChars: prompt.length };
